shadows.label: 阴影 4 - Shadow 4
shadows.description: "Render a meditation session card: full-width minus 24pt margins, 200pt tall, 24pt corner radius. Background is a full-bleed illustration of a round-headed character meditating cross-legged on a hill, in soft pastel colors. Apply a `linear-gradient(transparent → rgba(46,26,71,0.6))` overlay bottom-up. Bottom-aligned content: a 'Stress' tag pill in Apercu 13pt Semibold white on `rgba(255,255,255,0.25)` glass background (full pill 500pt corner). Below the pill: 'Stress Release' title in Apercu 22pt Bold white. Below the title: 'Andy Puddicombe · 10 min' in Apercu 13pt Regular white @ 85%. Shadow `rgba(46,26,71,0.08) 0 4px 16px` — warm and soft."

borders.label: 边框 3 - Border 3
borders.description: Headspace is a hand-drawn morning — warm, slow, and humanly imperfect. Where Nike Run Club is a stadium and Strava is a stopwatch, Headspace is a pottery studio. The canvas is butter-cream (`#FFF7E7`) — never pure white, never gray — and the palette behaves like a sunset gradient: a marigold orange (`#FF6B35`), a butter yellow (`#FFD25C`), a moss sage (`#7E9F4B`), and a deep dusk-eggplant (`#2E1A47`) for surface contrast. Every screen looks like a children's book illustration of a meditation: spheres breathe, characters smile, gradients soften everything. Headspace is the most distinctive UI in the entire wellness category because it commits fully to its illustration style rather than relying on photography.

borders.label: 边框 4 - Border 4

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段
panels.body: 按钮、输入、卡片和间距样例保持克制，便于比较不同主题的系统性差异。

do: 建议：Use Butter Cream {#FFF7E7} for the canvas — never pure white, never cool gray。
建议：Use Marigold {#FF6B35} as the primary action color — Start, Continue, Save。
建议：Apply the Aurora gradient (Marigold → Butter → Coral) on Today hero and meditation full-bleed cards。
建议：Render the breathing sphere as a radial gradient ({#FFB89E} highlight → {#FF6B35} mid → {#E55A2B} shadow) with continuous breath animation。
建议：Use Apercu (or Nunito as fallback) — soft humanist sans, never grotesque。
dont: 避免：use pure white as the canvas — Headspace is warm-cream by brand。
避免：use harsh black {#000000} for text — Ink Brown {#2E1A47} is the value。
避免：use UPPERCASE on Apercu — title case only, never all-caps。
避免：replace illustration companions with photography — Headspace is fully illustrated。
避免：use cool blues or grotesque sans-serif typography — the brand is warm and humanist。
